run_clevrer_model: run the ClevrerTransformerModel on a CLEVRER scene to answer descriptive and multiple-choice questions
load_monet_latents: load MONet latent representations from a .npz file for a given CLEVRER scene index
encode_sentence: encode a CLEVRER question or choice sentence into a padded sequence of token IDs
encode_choices: encode multiple CLEVRER choice sentences into a padded array of token ID sequences
eval_descriptive: evaluate a descriptive CLEVRER question using the transformer model and return the predicted answer
